session.about: GOLDEN - the session and its runs (operator 2026-10-10: "There is the wire-pod session (wpr 2 until next wpr 2) * Goverlord is the wpr-session orchestrator"; "drop, yes, and one pass"; gopod_session.go, ALIAS-PLAY-STUDIO.md "The session"). Goverlord keeps the one record of the session's phase (warming, ready, run) and the run going. One run at a time: the draft (start interview), the song engine (start bingo test, start baby brobots, pha0b live) and phcal live all check in and out with Goverlord (/api-sdk/gopod_run). A second start while a run is going gets busy_text. While a run is going it owns the Brobots: no chat hold, no live LLM answers; only stop run, thanks, Record Session's answer and the draft's own lines get through - anything else gets run_gate_text (at most every 5 s) and is dropped. A run that was stopped says stopped_text. A run whose process is gone without checking out is cleared.

app.about: 2026-10-24 (FINISH_PLAN_001.md C3; operator: "Go on C3 for my phone"): GOPOD as a phone app. A phone offers Install app only for a secure page, so Wire-Pod also serves GOPOD securely on https_port - the same pages. The certificate is GOPOD's own: a local authority named ca_name (made once, kept; the phone trusts it once from /gopod_ca.crt) and a server certificate for this machine's names and addresses, made again when they change. All in cert_dir (private, the operator's home, never the repo). The app opens on the chat (gopod_manifest.json, start ?app).
app.fence_about: 2026-10-31 (operator: "CA fencing"; ACCESSMATH_APP_INSTALL_001.md): the fence written into GOPOD's authority (X.509 name constraints, critical) - it may only ever vouch for names under fence_dns (and this machine's own hostname) and addresses in fence_ips: the local network, never a public name. An authority made before its fence is kept aside (ca_unfenced_<time>) and a fenced one made at the next start; phones trust /gopod_ca.crt once again. Only the machine's names inside the fence go in its server certificate.

visitors.about: 2026-10-24 (operator: "set me apart by my local PC & Laptop IP addresses ... everyone else is a visitor ... allow a chat participant gathering * initially visitor chat participation is OFF"): the admin is GOPOD's own machine or a device in admin_addresses_file (private, outside the repo: one address a line); everyone else is a visitor, one per device. A visitor's first line is their username request (first come, first served; taken: name1, name2); lines after it are dropped until the admin approves it in the system window (Local network visitors). participation (starts OFF) and each approved visitor's box (unticked = muted) let their lines through, under their username. A dropped line tells them waiting_text or muted_text. A visitor never runs the show (commands dropped). seen_seconds: a nameless visitor stays listed this long after their page last reported in. name_max: the longest username.
visitors.profiles_file_about: 2026-10-24 (operator: "Save the visitor profile in case of a disconnect reconnect, like the brobot reboot recovery thing"): each visitor's username, approval and mute box, kept here (private, outside the repo) and back after a dropped connection or a restart - by the phone's own browser ID, so a new network address is still the same visitor.
